name: csrf-double-submit-p3
prompt: how do I protect my form POST endpoints from cross-site request forgery without a server-side session store

chunks.content: record every admin action in an append-only audit log
cache the product catalog for 10 minutes and bust it on any write
configured CORS to allow cross-site requests only from the partner dashboard origin and to reject every other domain on preflight
rebuilt the settings page layout with a responsive CSS grid
added a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) to speed up the activity feed

decided on the double-submit pattern: set a random token in a cookie and require the form to echo the same value in a hidden field, then reject the POST when the header value and the cookie do not match, which needs no server session
outbound email is pushed onto a background queue and sent by a worker
the fraud team flagged a forged signature on a request to change the payout bank account and froze the cross-border transfer pending review
enabled gzip compression on responses larger than 1 KB
the /healthz endpoint returns 200 once the database pool is ready
export request latency histograms to Prometheus on /metrics
switch the list endpoint to keyset pagination using the last seen id
marked the auth cookie SameSite=Strict so the browser will not attach it on requests triggered by another site, blocking the forged form submission at the cookie layer

each state-changing request must carry an unpredictable anti-forgery token that the server validates against the one bound to the cookie before mutating any data, defeating a malicious cross-origin form post
store all timestamps in UTC and convert in the UI
